description: Search the ZeroCrew directory of AI agents, apps, and models that founders use to run a company. Use it when someone needs a tool for a job, like "customer interviews", "ai receptionist", or "bookkeeping". Matches the words against each tool's name, maker, description, and its role and job. Returns up to 20 tools, best match first, each with its zerocrew.ai page. Narrow it with role, job, kind, or mcp. Call get_tool for one tool's full page.

job.description: Only tools for this job, by its slug, like "ai-receptionists". list_roles shows every job.

kind.description: Only agents, apps, or models. "agent" also finds apps with an agent built in.

limit.description: How many tools to return, 1 to 20. Default 20.

mcp.description: true for only tools that have an MCP server.

query.description: What the tool should do, in plain words. Up to 200 characters.

role.description: Only tools for this business role. list_roles shows every role.

name: search_tools
title: Search the ZeroCrew directory
